what: Design sized a private scratch CB as N*1024 B pages + 64 B alignment slack; CircularBufferConfig throws unless total_size is a multiple of page_size (circular_buffer_config.cpp:93). Nothing in the references states this rule, so planners keep writing non-page-multiple slack.
suggest: State the total_size % page_size == 0 rule in the CB/L1 references; for slack, use page_size = slack unit or add a whole page.

suggest: Detect trace capture at runtime (hook begin_trace_capture during the collect pass), or document that golden helpers must keep capture calls in the test body.
